scope: retrospective raw-atom evidence-retention study; relative evidence-cost units only
claim_boundary: Conditional replacement robustness and offline sufficient-evidence retention only. This protocol does not identify lesion causality, establish real acquisition-time savings, provide clinical deployment validation, or replace pathology review.
outer_split: leave-one-centre-out reused exactly from Formal v1

counterfactual_distribution.main: source-train donor pool; matched on atom kind/position and declared clinical nuisance stratum when available; no outcome label is used for donor selection
counterfactual_distribution.test_centre_rule: Held-out recipients use source-train donors only. Same-centre matching is unavailable by design at a held-out centre and is recorded as a transport donor condition.

policies.C1_attention_fixed_budget: same no-CSS backbone; attention-ranked offline retention at source-validation matched budget
policies.C2_cev_fixed_budget: same no-CSS backbone; predicted-class conditional counterfactual value ranked offline retention at matched budget
policies.C3_cev_adaptive: same no-CSS backbone; CEV-ranked sufficient-evidence stopping
policies.random_fixed_budget: negative selection control matched to C3 validation budget

primary_estimand: macro-centre AUPRC of the three-seed ensemble on held-out cases

bootstrap.unit: patient sampled within centre and outcome strata
bootstrap.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within the predeclared primary C4-versus-policy family

falsification_rules.M1: CEV high-ranked atoms must show larger held-out observed-label replacement loss than matched attention-ranked and matched random atoms under main_matched q.
falsification_rules.M2: C3 must expose a performance-cost frontier rather than merely report a lower atom count; C3 is not supported if the fixed-budget or uncertainty-only controls provide the same frontier.
falsification_rules.M3: C4 must improve held-out centre rank/stopping stability or worst-centre performance relative to C3; otherwise CSS has no demonstrated role.
falsification_rules.safety: No clinical safety claim is made. Calibration and threshold-based sensitivity changes are reported with uncertainty rather than interpreted as deployment safety.

unavailable_evidence_gates.temporal_validation: No structured acquisition date is available in the frozen manifest; image-path timestamps are not treated as a validated temporal reference.
unavailable_evidence_gates.independent_external_hospital: No sixth independent hospital cohort has been supplied.
unavailable_evidence_gates.prospective_silent_study: Requires new data collection, protocol, and applicable ethics/governance review.
unavailable_evidence_gates.multi_reader_human_ai_study: No reader-study dataset or clinician-reader protocol has been supplied.
unavailable_evidence_gates.reviewed_roi_or_polygon: No clinician-reviewed ROI/polygon/bbox is used or inferred.
